behavior: When `Combobox.Input` or `Autocomplete.Input` renders an element that is not an `<input>`, such as a `<textarea>`, the browser keeps more of its caret keys. While the popup is closed, ArrowDown and ArrowUp move the caret between the lines and do not open the popup. Such an element has no `role="combobox"` while the popup is closed, as in Base UI. While the popup is open, or when the list is inline, the two keys move the highlight. Home and End go to the browser in each state, also when the input is in the popup. Base UI opens the popup for ArrowDown and ArrowUp. For Home and End, it moves the caret to the start or the end of the whole text. When the input is in the popup, it also moves the highlight to the first or the last item.
